Nursing Studio respects your privacy.
1. Information we collect • Basic registration details: name, email, mobile number, gender, education, occupation and address (as shared by you). • Exam-related preferences: nursing exams and categories you are interested in. • App usage information: which screens or features are used (for improving the app in future). • Device information: basic device details (Android version, app version, crash reports).
We do NOT intentionally collect: • Sensitive financial data (card / UPI details) • Any clinical patient data
2. How we use your information We use your information to: • Create and manage your Nursing Studio account • Show you relevant content (tests, PDFs, videos) • Improve app features and fix bugs • Send important updates (for example: new test series, feature changes), only if notifications are enabled
3. Data storage and security • Your data is stored securely using Android’s local storage and/or our online services (if used in future). • We try to protect your information with reasonable technical safeguards, but no system is 100% secure.
4. Third-party services If we use any third-party services in future (for example: analytics, ads, payment gateway), they may receive some limited information as per their own privacy policies. Details will be updated here whenever such services are added.
5. Your choices • You can update most of your basic details in the profile section. • You can control notification preferences from the Settings screen. • If you want your account/data to be removed in future versions, you will be able to request deletion through in-app options or by contacting support.
6. Children’s privacy Nursing Studio is designed for adult students preparing for nursing competitive exams. It is not targeted at children under 13 years.
7. Contact & support If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us through: • WhatsApp support link given in the Settings page (or official support email once it is available).
By using the Nursing Studio app, you agree to this Privacy Policy. This policy may be updated in future and the latest version will always be shown inside the app.
